failure_summary.description: New searches or filters were generated without saving their results, despite existing save-to-cache guidance.
The agent either reran already-satisfied cached searches or searched anew instead of filtering a compatible cached result.
A complete independent restaurant search was skipped, or an explicitly requested round trip was not split into outbound and return legs.
A generic kid-friendly request was incorrectly mapped to pet-friendly hotels.

patch.reasoning: These failures are already addressed by the skill’s cache-saving, cached-follow-up, independent-domain, round-trip, and unsupported-preference rules. Similar proposed additions were rejected in prior steps, so repeating them would duplicate existing guidance rather than patch a demonstrated gap.
